items.title: Synology fixes BeeStation zero-days demoed at Pwn2Own Ireland
items.description: Synology has addressed a critical-severity remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in BeeStation products that was demonstrated at the recent Pwn2Own hacking competition. [...]

items.title: ZDI-CAN-28101: Qwen
items.description: A CVSS score 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Peter Girnus (@gothburz) and Brandon Niemczyk of Trend Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-11-11, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-03-11 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
